name: NPM-GW
tagline: Up to 104,000 cph for large-capacity production

intro.text: The Panasonic NPM-GW is a G-series placement machine for larger-capacity production. Lighter heads, shorter moving distances, higher X-axis acceleration and Auto Setting Feeders raise productivity and board flexibility, and it supports remote operation within Panasonic's Autonomous Factory concept.

items: Up to 104,000 cph with the FC16 head
Chips from 0201 up to larger packages
Auto Setting Feeders (ASF) and Intelligent Tape Feeders (ITF) reduce loading time and downtime
Dual conveyor for long and short PCBs; remote operation

rows: L 50 × W 50 to L 760 × W 687 mm
L 50 × W 50 to L 360 × W 687 mm
W 1,410 × D 2,320 × H 1,444 mm (standard); D 2,478 mm with two 30-slot ITF carts
2,810 kg (standard); 2,840 kg with two 30-slot ITF carts

blocks.text: Standard specifications from Panasonic. Actual performance depends on board, components and line conditions.
